reason: Deny-by-default capability decision seam for sandboxed web-bundles. Its own docs state that wiring it into a real postMessage listener / origin host is device/ecosystem work (docs/permissions-sandbox-audit-plan.md Phase 3) and intentionally not faked. UPDATE (2026-09-13, REQ-A169/A170): the *origin host* half now exists (ExtAppHost.svelte + the amos-app:// bundle host), so what is still missing is precisely the other half — the postMessage listener and the daemon `perm_authorize` chokepoint behind it. Nothing in the shell has a capability to hand out yet, which is why every frame stays deny-by-default.

Read-only view model for standard Android collections served by the media_* bridge. Awaits the Files screen's external-collection section; until then it is a documented, tested library surface ('Wire: crates/amos-media -> media_list -> this lib').

name: setCellularRadio
reason: Install a REAL cellular radio+signal reading into the Notification Center store. There is no host yet: amos-tauri exposes no cellular-signal command, so the store stays at the honest `absent` default ('no modem' → no bars). This is device bring-up (Android TelephonyManager/RadioSignal on the Rust side); wiring it now would fabricate a signal source.

name: clearCellularRadio
reason: Teardown half of setCellularRadio: restore the honest `absent` default. Same missing host as setCellularRadio — it becomes reachable only once a device radio source installs one.
